CooldownComment: Cooldown duration in seconds between item pickups.
PickNearbyItemsComment: Enable or disable the ability to pick up nearby items of the same type.
NearbyPickupRadiusComment: Radius in blocks for picking up nearby items of the same type when enabled.
AllowPickupWithFullHandComment: Allow players to pick up items even if their hand is not empty.
RestrictToMatchingHandItemComment: Restrict item pickup to match the item in the players main hand.
RemoveSneakRequirementComment: Removes the pick up while sneaking feature from Only Pick Up sneaking vanilla config.
EnableLoggingComment: Enable or disable debug logging for the mod.
